title: Massive Attack · Teardrop
description: A copper-lit seed pod hangs in an underwater glasshouse. Ripples and drifting fragments follow the pulse of the song.

performance.lyrics: Love, love is a firk, love is a doom and word, Fearless on my brain. Gentle and potion Shakes me, makes me lighter Fear lies somewhere great Teardrop on fire Fear lies somewhere great Night, Ah night of the day Black flowers blossom Fear there is some man Brave, Ah like flowers blossom, fear the summer grey Ah Tea drop and fire, fear the summer Ah Ah Thank you very much.
